title: Exact restriction and normalized adjunction for the independent-universe tensor model
statement: Let C be a category with independent object and morphism universes, r a coefficient universe, J a Grothendieck topology with additive sheafification and its locally-bijective detection, and commutative-ring forgetful composition. For commutative ring sheaves O,Oprime and phi:O -> Oprime, restriction [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars] preserves finite limits and finite colimits. Every additive functor E presenting changeOfRingsOfUniverses [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] on both objects and maps is left adjoint to that restriction. The Hom correspondence on eqToHom(h M) followed by f sends a local section x to f of the sheafification class of 1 tensor x, using [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification].

source.place: Tag 03CZ, lemma-adjointness-tensor-restrict; Tag 03DA, lemma-abelian; Tag 03DB, lemma-limits-colimits

proof.text: Construct the sectionwise extension/restriction Hom equivalence between tensor presheaf maps and restriction maps. Pure-tensor naturality makes these module-presheaf maps. Compose with the module sheafification Hom equivalence. The two-variable naturality constructs the adjunction; its Hom map is the stated 1-tensor formula. Transport along the natural isomorphism from the supplied object and map equalities.

Restriction followed by forgetting to additive sheaves is the same forgetful functor as before restriction. That functor preserves finite limits and finite colimits and reflects them. Apply the reflection-of-preservation lemmas to obtain both exactness instances.

theorem scalarLocalizationCoefficientAdjunctionOfUniverses (φ : O ⟶ O') :
    ∃ (_ : PreservesFiniteLimits (restrictScalars.{r}
                    ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).map φ)))
      (_ : PreservesFiniteColimits (restrictScalars.{r}
                    ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).map φ))),
    ∀ (E : SheafOfModules.{r} (((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O)) ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{r} (((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O')))
      (h : ∀ M, E.obj M = changeOfRingsOfUniverses φ M),
      (∀ {M N} (f : M ⟶ N), E.map f =
        eqToHom (h M) ≫ changeOfRingsHomOfUniverses φ M f ≫ eqToHom (h N).symm) →
      ∀ [E.Additive], ∃ a : E ⊣ restrictScalars
          ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).map φ),
        (∀ (M : SheafOfModules.{r} (((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O)))
          (N : SheafOfModules.{r} (((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O')))
          (f : changeOfRingsOfUniverses φ M ⟶ N) (U : Cᵒᵖ) (x : M.val.obj U),
          (a.homEquiv M N (eqToHom (h M) ≫ f)).val.app U x =
            f.val.app U
              ((CategoryTheory.toSheafify J (changeOfRingsPresheafOfUniverses φ M).presheaf).app U
                ((1 : O'.obj.obj U) ⊗ₜ[O.obj.obj U, (φ.hom.app U).hom] x)))
